newsitem.title: USA: Williams Cos Inc unit buys California co.
newsitem.headline: Williams Cos Inc unit buys California co.

text.p: Williams Telecommunications Systems Inc said Friday it has bought SoftIRON Systems Inc, a California network systems integrator, for undisclosed terms.
Williams Telecommunications, or WilTel, is a unit of Williams Cos Inc based in Houston that provides businesses with Internet services and other communications services.
SoftIRON designs, installs and supports data systems and maintains more than 200 sites with high-speed data switches, 5,000 remote access ports, and networks managing more than 15,000 devices.
